name: Databricks Dolly 15k
description: An instruction-following dataset of approximately 15,000 human-generated prompts and responses created by Databricks employees, covering tasks such as brainstorming, classification, closed- and open-ended question answering, generation, information extraction, and summarization.
citation: Databricks. (2023). Free Dolly: Introducing the World's First Truly Open Instruction-Tuned LLM. https://www.databricks.com/blog/2023/04/12/dolly-first-open-instruction-tuned-llm
